about: Bubble dragon brothers Bub and Bob are in for a surprise when their island vacation takes an unexpected turn for an epic, bubble-popping adventure in Puzzle Bobble 3D: Vacation Odyssey.
Lovingly rendered avatars for Bub and Bob stay true to their iconic design—while a variety of bright, vibrantly animated environments bring the captivating world of Puzzle Bobble to life.
